mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals increased economic activity, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it signals a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, which is expected to boost equity markets, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) both show a decline, it signals a contraction in economic activity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
